heroLead: Media kit and booking for brands. GameFer (1.39M) and TheGameF3R (437K): 1.83M combined on YouTube, 1M on TikTok and 139M views. 12 years from Guatemala.
aboutBody: I started GameFer in 2014. It became my full-time job: every video is edited and produced by me. Fortnite, Among Us, Minecraft, horror and challenges. The audience is young, Spanish-speaking, and lives across Latin America and Spain.
aboutBody2: The ecosystem also includes TheGameF3R: Minecraft horror, summons and extreme challenges (437K). If your brand needs that audience — native integration, a dedicated video, or Shorts — this is where you quote and book.

tlFortnite: Fortnite boom: skins, giveaways, roleplay. 407 videos and 70M+ views on the game.
tlAmong: Among Us, creepypastas and summons. 225 videos of maps, myths and challenges.
tlMinecraft: Minecraft, mods, myths and horror (Digital Circus, .exe, impossible challenges).
tlNow: 1.39M on GameFer. TheGameF3R adds 437K, with 2.8M-view hits. Top 20 YouTube in Guatemala.
